verdict.rationale: Warp explicitly publishes its client source code on GitHub (warpdotdev/warp) under the AGPL v3 open-source license, confirmed by multiple first-party docs and a dedicated blog post announcing the open-sourcing. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that the released source matches the shipped binaries and clarity on how much of the AI/agent backend (vs. just the terminal client) is covered by the license.
